note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens. The two workbooks are generated locally by the episode's own excelfake tool and uploaded in the portal; the trigger polls (up to five minutes).
prepare: # owner signs in: browser profiles for labadmin (SharePoint, Excel on the web, make.powerautomate.com, Outlook) and jordan.demo (uploads the price list). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-4): upload out\Purchasing catalogue.xlsx to Purchasing > Documents; create the Office Script 'Upsert prices' from src\officescript\UpsertPrices.ts and move it to Documents/Scripts; library Price lists with folder Rejected; solution Price lists (PriceLists) with its environment variables and the flow 'Supplier price list import', turned on
# owner (demo.md Setup 8): as jordan.demo upload out\Fabrikam price list 2026-12.xlsx to Price lists and wait for the real run

screens.name: library
steps: Open the library 'Price lists' on the Purchasing site and show 'Fabrikam price list 2026-12.xlsx' uploaded by Jordan Demo
Insert: open the workbook in Excel on the web, table Prices (Item No., Description, Unit price, Valid from)
Scroll to the bottom: 400 rows and the four bad rows (empty item number, n/a, 12,50, -3.2)
mask: tenant name in the address bar, the SharePoint header and the Excel header

screens.name: run
steps: Open the run history of 'Supplier price list import' and the real run for 'Fabrikam price list 2026-12.xlsx'
Show every action green, 'Too many rows' false and 'Stop not all rows read' skipped
Open the output panel of 'List price rows': 400 items; open its Settings to show pagination On, threshold 5000
Expand 'Upsert catalogue' output: result with inserted 15, updated 288, unchanged 92, duplicatesInFile 1, duplicateRowsInCatalogue 1 and bigChanges FAB-0100, FAB-0200, FAB-0300
mask: site URLs, drive IDs (b!...) and the script ID in the action inputs
environment ID in the address bar

screens.name: catalogue
steps: Open 'Purchasing catalogue.xlsx' in Excel on the web, table Catalogue
Show FAB-0005 with the new price and both FAB-0007 rows with the same new price
Scroll to the end and show FAB-0381 to FAB-0395 appended, Valid from 2026-12-01 as a date and Source 'Fabrikam price list 2026-12.xlsx'
Optional insert: Automate tab, the 'Upsert prices' script in the Code Editor
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the Excel header

screens.name: email
steps: Open the mail 'Price list Fabrikam price list 2026-12.xlsx: 288 updated, 15 new, 4 rejected'
Show the counts and the HTML table with FAB-0100, FAB-0200 and FAB-0300
Insert: open Price lists/Rejected/Fabrikam price list 2026-12-rejected.csv in Excel and show the four rows with the Problem column
mask: tenant domain in the mailbox address
tenant name in the suite bar and the Excel header

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn the flow off (and delete the pagination-off copy if one was made); delete the uploaded price lists and the Rejected CSVs; keep the Upsert prices script and the solution for episode 9 or delete them
